rollups.text: Health events and concerns: lingering cough/bronchitis lasting several weeks, with Dr. Smith diagnosing bronchitis on 2023-03-03; the user tried guaifenesin, an antibiotic, steam inhalation, and honey, but still reported nighttime discomfort and coughing on 2023-03-27 and considered discussing a chest X-ray with Dr. Smith. Heartburn and acid reflux began around late January 2023; the user adjusted their diet, used antacids as needed, and considered asking gastroenterologist Dr. Patel about treatment, natural remedies, and stress management on 2023-03-27. Left-hand numbness was noticed around 2023-03-15; an EMG with neurologist Dr. Johnson was scheduled for 2023-04-01, and the user planned medical follow-up and symptom tracking on 2023-03-27. The user was recovering from a torn ACL: Dr. Thompson said the knee was healing well at a 2023-03-20 follow-up, and physical therapy was scheduled to begin 2023-03-25, twice weekly.
